answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 5585 Country: India Title: Is it that our prayers (Salah) will be incomplete (Makrooh) if we offer it wearing a half sleeves shirt? Question: Asalamu Alikum Is it that our prayers (Salah) will be incomplete (Makrooh) if we offer it wearing a half sleeves shirt. wasalaam. Answer ID: 5585 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa182/182=M/1429) The jurists have said that it is undesirable to perform salah while raising sleeves above elbow. It is in Muraqi Al-Falah : و تشمیر کمیہ عنھما للنھی عنہ لما فیہ من الجفاء المنافی للخشوع Though there is difference between a half-sleeved-shirt and raising sleeves but both are similar; therefore salah in half-sleeved-shirt without any proper reason will be makrooh . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
